goal: UX, QA, security, and similar roles exist as explicit agent definitions with boundaries
scenarios: the catalog lists UX, QA, security, and similar specialist agent definitions with role, responsibilities, allowed task types, allowed tools, required skills, and output expectations
a new project enables planner, generator, and evaluator only; specialist agents stay disabled until selected
enabling a specialist agent lets a run produce that agent's output and attach it to a WorkItem
disabling a specialist agent prevents new runs with that agent
a project can customize a specialist agent's allowed tools within its built-in boundary
constraints: technology skill packs are out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
